20414121.name: Blaze Howl - B
20414121.describe: A newly refined Blaze Howl flamethrower. Although many complain that the new version lacks the rugged aesthetic UKB-1 is known for, it offers significant improvements in versatility and control compared to the old Blaze Howl.

20414122.name: Blaze Howl - B II
20414122.describe: 经过精密改良后的新式炎啸喷火器。尽管很多人抱怨说，新式改良款缺少了联合设计局式的粗犷美感。但在泛用性和可控性上相比旧款炎啸都获得了大幅提升。

20415121.name: Kagutsuchi
20415121.describe: Once a common top-end flamethrower, now reworked by Erisa into something new. After connecting the power unit, it leaves a blazing trail of flames behind her. For this independent researcher, who is constantly pursued by the major forces, it boosts her escape probability by a few percentage points on top of the base 100%.

20415122.name: Mirage Haze
20415122.describe: 「一份微不足道的礼物，送给通过考验之人……呵，我们迟早还会再见的。」

20215121.name: Bahamut
20215121.describe: "You once said that a soldier's purpose is to obey orders, yet your mission defies that belief. Lieutenant Colonel, do you still have even a hint of compassion for humanity?"

20214121.name: Behemoth - B
20214121.describe: Upgraded with external cooling pipes and multi-box ammunition compartments, it enhances self-cooling and boasts improved safety and durability.

20214122.name: Behemoth - B II
20214122.describe: Upgraded with external cooling pipes and multi-box ammunition compartments, it enhances self-cooling and boasts improved safety and durability.

20215122.name: Gaius
20215122.describe: A specially crafted weapon that suddenly appeared in Ludwig's old laboratory. The developer and development time are completely unknown, and the technology is difficult to trace. It can only be determined from the remaining test data that it was created for a certain young man.

20115122.name: Evenstar Successor
20115122.describe: A specially modified machine gun based on the Nightwither and tailored entirely to Cassha's combat style. A gift from a fallen comrade and a symbol of Vesper's mission—the designer has long since fallen like a shooting star, but the light of Vesper will never fade.

20115121.name: Fate's Aria
20115121.describe: A special edition Nightwither, created from Rosa Diaz's data, featuring brainwave-controlled Arashium for activation. Surprisingly, this weapon has never been used by Valkyrie, despite being part of her arsenal.

20114121.name: Nightwither - B
20114121.describe: The Nightwither - B, Obsidian's new and improved machine gun with a built-in FCS chip linked to Arashium units. This technology allows pilots to create a direct neural connection, delivering exceptional control and precision in combat.

20114122.name: Nightwither - B II
20114122.describe: The Nightwither - B, Obsidian's new and improved machine gun with a built-in FCS chip linked to Arashium units. This technology allows pilots to create a direct neural connection, delivering exceptional control and precision in combat.

20114123.name: Nightwither - B III
20114123.describe: 黑曜石推出的新型机枪武装，是知名机枪武器夜魇的最新改型。内置了与钢岚机兵相连的火控芯片，支持神经直连控制机兵武装直接开火。

20115123.name: Peace Function
20115123.describe: 为了庆祝萨普里娅康复，帕洛玛向地平线公司定制的特型机枪。其各项参数完全以萨普里娅个人的作战风格为基准，植入了传感元件与微型演算单元，也有效提升了与咕咕的连携作战能力。据说帕洛玛为它准备了16个独特而复杂的名字，但最终都没有被采纳。

20315121.name: Cinder
20315121.describe: From its inception, an ideal belongs to no one alone. So, even if the initiator has already given up and betrayed that founding notion, an ideal can find its own successor to carry it forward... Now, it is time for him to carry the torch.

20314121.name: Firebolt - B
20314121.describe: In addition to the superior fire control components added to the old Firebolt model, support for the onboard booster module has been completely upgraded. This makes it the absolute king among current mass-produced shotgun weapons.

20314122.name: Firebolt - B II
20314122.describe: In addition to the superior fire control components added to the old Firebolt model, support for the onboard booster module has been completely upgraded. This makes it the absolute king among current mass-produced shotgun weapons.

20315122.name: Tropic Calamity
20315122.describe: The weapon Frida used when she was the "Queen of the Northwest Jungle." But strangely, ever since she gave up working alone to form a mercenary group, her territory has been shrinking day by day.

50214121.name: Foehn - B
50214121.describe: A new Cutter developed by the Horizon Weapon Laboratory. While its core principles differ little from the original Foehn series, its direct-link Sync Ratio load restrictions have been dramatically relaxed. As a result, aside from a handful of theoretical "target prototypes," it is effectively unusable by standard pilots.

50214122.name: Foehn - B II
50214122.describe: 诞生于地平线武器实验室的新式浮游炮武器，在原理上与原生的焚风系列没有太大区别，但大幅放宽了直连同步率的负荷限制，除了理论上的那几位「目标原型」外，几乎不能为常规驾驶员使用。

50216121.name: Heaven's Judgment
50216121.describe: 她看到，自己将铁雨带到大地，把昙花落于火海。她还听到，那些熟悉的、悲伤的、冒失的声音，一次又一次的呼唤自己……直至黄昏到来。既然长梦已醒，那就不要再睡去，接受一切，背负一切，去给那些高高在上的众神……带来属于他们的「审判」。

50215122.name: Thousand Legion
50215122.describe:
「抱歉，科林长官，现代科技没法造出您口中同时拥有重火力、半永久动力、高机动性的高智能自动武装……作为替代，我们为您设计了这一新型浮游炮，希望它能帮助您平定米赫玛局势。
最后，请不要每天都给我发需求邮件！！！」

50215121.name: Twilight of the Gods
50215121.describe: She sees iron rain fall at her command, blossoms cast into flames. She hears the familiar voices—sad, reckless—calling her name, over and over... until dusk comes. The long dream is over. She will not sleep again. She will accept it all, carry it all, and deliver to those high-seated gods... their rightful Judgment.

40115122.name: Converse Meteor
40115122.describe: After countless failed attempts, this redesigned missile launcher was finally completed, with safety mechanisms removed and an additional warhead bay installed. Its creator believes that as long as its missiles streak through the air with burning intensity, the light of Vesper will never fade.

40115121.name: Cooool!
40115121.describe: The GSA's advanced ST-mounted missile for special agents was set to be named "Indra" due to its superior performance. Unfortunately, the agent forgot its name the day after extraction.

40114121.name: Kumara - B
40114121.describe: The upgraded Kumara model, equipped with a warhead chip, offers improved firepower and accuracy, along with expanded fuel support for diverse environments and combat situations.

40114122.name: Kumara - B II
40114122.describe: The upgraded Kumara model, equipped with a warhead chip, offers improved firepower and accuracy, along with expanded fuel support for diverse environments and combat situations.

50116121.name: Adjudicator
50116121.describe: A new masterpiece that combines a jammer with an onboard rail gun, overcoming the challenge of integrating a backpack with a rail gun base for the very first time. This makes the Adjudicator a unique weapon that combines interference with long-range tactical strikes.

50115123.name: Codex of Sin
50115123.describe: 「维娜小姐，请收下这份礼物。对您这样在前线奔走的人而言，这款加装了大型弹仓和增压加速单元的新式电磁炮一定会派上用场……呵呵，您可以将这理解为一次投资，希望您能在未来与我们角雕商会建立长期稳定的合作关系。」

50115121.name: Lucent
50115121.describe: "Shawnee, this security personnel position is nothing but a ruse they fabricated to rope you in! If this continues, you'll only ever be dispatched by the council without any chance to... You say it's to protect civilians at the executive level? Haha, only I'd be dumb enough to believe something like that..."

50115122.name: Strawberry Macaroni
50115122.describe: "...I had a bad feeling the moment you said we were picking something up from the dock warehouse—but I never imagined your idea of a 'little snack' would be a rail gun! I-I mean, I was surprised, but maybe next time you give someone a gift, you should check what they actually want first... And also—don't just paint something like 'Little Fia' on the shipping container for everyone to see!"

50116122.name: Sugar-Coated Destroyer
50116122.describe: A new test armament that perfectly integrates a universal amplifier with an onboard Rail Gun, offering a new solution to the conflict over space and power between pack and turret. Its exceptional long-range firepower may well redefine future battlefield tactics.

50114121.name: Torch Tower - B
50114121.describe: A modified Torch Tower that integrates both plasma projectiles and kinetic rounds into a single rail gun, allowing for more diverse strike forms based on specific battlefield environments and tactical needs.

50114122.name: Torch Tower - B II
50114122.describe: A modified Torch Tower that integrates both plasma projectiles and kinetic rounds into a single rail gun, allowing for more diverse strike forms based on specific battlefield environments and tactical needs.

50114123.name: Torch Tower - B III
50114123.describe: 将电浆弹与推射弹同时集成在一款电磁炮上的炬塔改款，能根据具体的作战环境与战术需求选择更多样的打击形式。

40214121.name: Molten - B
40214121.describe: Equipped with a newly developed custom guidance module specially crafted by Obsidian, this airborne rocket launcher can execute more refined and precise bombing commands according to pilot requirements, greatly expanding its tactical value.

40214122.name: Molten - B II
40214122.describe: 加装了由黑曜石特别研制的新型自制导组件的机载火箭，能根据机师需求执行更加精细、精确的轰炸命令，大大拓展了火箭武器的战术价值。

40215121.name: RA-09
40215121.describe: "Highest corporate authorization complete. Inspector Eileen, you may proceed to Milkhama Island to search for the rumored test subject, but I still advise you to wait for the board's formal vote to obtain the authority to deploy the Mobile Guard... Alright, final confirmation—you intend to go alone, into the depths of hell, correct?"

40215122.name: Veto
40215122.describe: 为了应对越发混乱的米赫玛局势，联合安全总署为罗斯玛丽特制的新型火箭弹。在增加装药量的同时采用了最新的同步火控模块，拥有极为惊人的广域打击能力。如果这件武器出现在战场上，就代表那位运筹于幕后的「夫人」已决定摧毁棋局。

10914121.name: Excalibur - B
10914121.describe: The improved model of the general purpose blade Excalibur, fully optimized with a deformation structure and an added micro-control unit, enhancing both handling and contact strength, and significantly boosting combat efficiency.

10915121.name: Δ-09
10915121.describe: A prototype power blade crafted by the UNCS Ninth Research Institute. Σ-04 Ophelia took it as a trophy after defeating the runaway experiment Δ-09, and she's used it ever since... People say they were once friends, but Ophelia has never said a word about it.

10515124.name: Delicate
10515124.describe: 联合安全总署特别改制的机兵手盾。不同于常规加固升级，该型手盾增设了传感器与微型演算模组，强调协助机兵采取优势策略以实现更立体的攻防。攻即守，守为攻，玲珑百变，无处捉摸——正如其使用者，高级探员安德森的行事风格。

10515123.name: Elegiac Prism
10515123.describe: "Melissa, only in the end did I realize that the one who could open this cage was you alone... It couldn't have ended any better than this."

10514121.name: Polymeric Barrier - B
10514121.describe: The new Polymeric Barrier replaces the old Jamming Coat and Harvesting Core, significantly improving ballistic deflection protection and expanding the armor's coverage.

10514122.name: Polymeric Barrier - B II
10514122.describe: The new Polymeric Barrier replaces the old Jamming Coat and Harvesting Core, significantly improving ballistic deflection protection and expanding the armor's coverage.

10514123.name: Polymeric Barrier - B III
10514123.describe: The new Polymeric Barrier replaces the old Jamming Coat and Harvesting Core, significantly improving ballistic deflection protection and expanding the armor's coverage.

10514124.name: Polymeric Barrier - B IV
10514124.describe: 将旧型干扰涂层和收束核心完全替换后的升级款聚合屏障，无论是针对弹道的偏转防御还是甲片扩张后的防护范围，对比旧型都有着巨大提升。

10515122.name: Power of the Mahalim
10515122.describe: The first few "Mahalim" in the refugee camp left behind a legacy—a cobbled-together ST made from all kinds of parts, accompanied by a set of spares for convenient repairs. Lorna hopes to commemorate all of them in this way and plans to use it to save more "Mahalim."

10515121.name: Sandwich Cookie
10515121.describe: Designed by the Lollipop Machine Shop, this enhanced multi-functional shield includes reinforced plates, repair parts, amplifier batteries, a mini-minesweeper, and a Pochy remote controller. Pre-orders are limited to select VIP customers, with the store manager's personal version not for sale.

10215121.name: Hunter's Sting
10215121.describe: "Camilla, this is for you... We'll be going back to that island soon. There, you'll reclaim not just all I've told you about, but everything you've lost."

10215122.name: Storm Stiller
10215122.describe: "Looking back upon the desolate path behind me... Homeward I go, untouched by rain or shine."

10214121.name: Triumph - B
10214121.describe: The Pile Bunker's original structure remains intact while a new thruster, linked directly to the ST's power module, enables faster, more precise, and controllable strikes.

10214122.name: Triumph - B II
10214122.describe: The Pile Bunker's original structure remains intact while a new thruster, linked directly to the ST's power module, enables faster, more precise, and controllable strikes.

10315121.name: False Obsession
10315121.describe: "I yearn to cry, laugh, roar, and run... I miss my mother's embrace and those carefree days. Whether in life or death, haunted by memories or seeking a fresh start, it's a pity my tears won't come, and there's no way back to the past..."

10315123.name: Godslayer
10315123.describe: 完全由高浓度岚原质打造的巨刃长枪，具备洞穿一切防御的力量。它本是计划中用来对抗利维坦的绝对兵器，但因设计者失踪而未能及时完成，如今不知为何以完成形态出现在路德维希旧实验室。

10314121.name: Mountains - B
10314121.describe: This upgraded polearm from Doll Industries features a built-in drive core that generates kinetic energy for strikes, enhancing flexibility and reducing weight for improved maneuverability.

10314122.name: Mountains - B II
10314122.describe: This upgraded polearm from Doll Industries features a built-in drive core that generates kinetic energy for strikes, enhancing flexibility and reducing weight for improved maneuverability.

10314123.name: Mountains - B III
10314123.describe: 多尔工业重整机兵生产线后推出的改良款长柄武器，以内置的驱动核心产生的打击动能代替武器的自重打击，大幅改善了操作的灵活性与轻便性。

10315122.name: Sivri
10315122.describe: Sometimes she dreams of that night, watching the moon with her adopted children... For this reason, she must firmly grasp the weapon in her hand and continue to fight fearlessly for countless more moonlit nights to come.

10814121.name: Beowulf - B
10814121.describe: An improved version of the Beowulf military combat axe-saw, featuring newly optimized turbo motors that significantly enhance durability and environmental adaptability, allowing the chainsaw weapon to excel in more diverse and complex combat environments.

10814122.name: Beowulf - B II
10814122.describe: 军用格斗斧锯贝奥武夫的改良款，全新优化后的涡轮马达在耐用性与环境适应性上均有显著提升，使得电锯武器能胜任更多样、更复杂的战斗环境。

10815122.name: Shattered Fang
10815122.describe: 米赫玛总督布莱尔为战友怀亚特所准备的特制动能锯，在两人因理念不合而分道扬镳后，它被长久存放于日沉谷军营仓库深处，直到怀亚特重返米赫玛，将其取出并翻新强化……即使已经过去十余年，它依然是对怀亚特而言最称手的武器。

10815121.name: Z15 Kinetic Axe
10815121.describe: A foldable Chainsaw cherished by Dean, capable of switching between sword and axe forms. Simply quote Dean's specially customized voice prompt "I say it's good to go!" to initiate transformation.

10415121.name: Cold Stele
10415121.describe: The back of this shield is intricately engraved with names, a gravestone selected by the Ghost of Ovett to honor what no longer exists. Though the dead have lost their place of return, he upholds their will and continues to fight.

10415122.name: Dawnstar Rampart
10415122.describe: According to Diracca, this specially crafted Large Shield is the unexpected reward she won in a DLAF arm-wrestling competition at the Defense Camp. Since then, arm-wrestling has become a staple pastime during the DLAF's off-duty hours.

10415124.name: Glory Bastion
10415124.describe: A specially forged shield that helped Tiphys withstand countless attacks, witnessing his rise as a hero of the DL. It should have retired in glory, yet it remains active on the battlefield, guarding his comrades... just as its master does.

10414121.name: Starfield - B
10414121.describe: The Starfield shield, utilizing UKB-1 lattice smelting technology, has a newly coated stamped plate that boosts strength and extends the interference device's range, greatly enhancing protection.

10414122.name: Starfield - B II
10414122.describe: The Starfield shield, utilizing UKB-1 lattice smelting technology, has a newly coated stamped plate that boosts strength and extends the interference device's range, greatly enhancing protection.

10414123.name: Starfield - B III
10414123.describe: The Starfield shield, utilizing UKB-1 lattice smelting technology, has a newly coated stamped plate that boosts strength and extends the interference device's range, greatly enhancing protection.

10414124.name: Starfield - B IV
10414124.describe: The Starfield shield, utilizing UKB-1 lattice smelting technology, has a newly coated stamped plate that boosts strength and extends the interference device's range, greatly enhancing protection.

30215123.name: Firework Scalpel
30215123.describe: 认为现役武器实在缺乏个性，帕洛玛缠着萨普里娅一同设计了这一新型狙击步枪。其各项参数完全以帕洛玛个人的作战风格为基准，陪她经历了多场重要战斗，曾一度令她爱不释手……不过现在，向来对新鲜事物三分钟热度的帕洛玛似乎又产生了进一步改修的念头。

30215121.name: Magic Flute
30215121.describe: Instruments, operas, rifles, and accordion sound pegs share the same name and lethality. The most haunting thought is whether she would choose a different path, if given the chance to return to the day the performance ended. She hesitates.

30214121.name: Red Fox - B
30214121.describe: The Red Fox - B sniper rifle now boasts an advanced calibration chip and sampling module in its particle beam sight, using ST detectors and trajectory simulation technology to enhance accuracy and usability.

30214122.name: Red Fox - B II
30214122.describe: The Red Fox - B sniper rifle now boasts an advanced calibration chip and sampling module in its particle beam sight, using ST detectors and trajectory simulation technology to enhance accuracy and usability.

30214123.name: Red Fox - B III
30214123.describe: 顶尖狙击枪赤狐的最新改款，在粒子射线瞄准器上加装了更加先进的校准芯片和采样模组。通过调用机兵侦测器和轨迹模拟技术进一步提高命中率和易用性。

30215122.name: Venus MK7
30215122.describe: A training sniper weapon specially commissioned by An-Holt, etched with the sniper takedown record set by Kelly Polis. To Kelly, this customized "teaching tool" likely outperforms any mass-produced standard weapon.

30115122.name: Arbiter of Fate
30115122.describe: 晨星同盟监察委员会为编号001379的精英探员特别定制的轻型步枪，安装有先进武器研究院设计的最新微型火控辅助模块，可精准锁定并确保命中敌机潜在弱点部位。

30114121.name: Maxx - B
30114121.describe: Equipped with An-Holt's latest optical sight and sampling prediction system, it improves maneuverability and durability over the original Maxx.

30114122.name: Maxx - B II
30114122.describe: 配备了安赫特公司最新研发的光瞄具与采样预测系统，并在旧式麦克斯的基础上进一步提升了操控性和耐用性。

30115121.name: Veiled Scent
30115121.describe: "I know flowers and clothes aren't your style, so I got you something different. Since you've never celebrated a birthday before, let's make today our shared birthday every year. Happy birthday, sis!"
